feed.text: U19 Asia Cup semi-finals set for Thursday: India U19 face Afghanistan U19 (10:30 am IST), Pakistan meet Bangladesh.
SAFF Championship: India need only a draw against Maldives today (3 pm IST, VETO) to reach the semi-finals after Pakistan beat Maldives 3–0.
Kumamoto Masters: Lakshya Sen opens against Chi Yu Jen around 2:40 pm IST; Treesa–Gayatri won their first-round match on Tuesday.
U19 Asia Cup: India U19 beat UAE U19 by 70 runs and reach the semi-finals — Aaryavir Sehwag 160, Ishan Sood 4/37.
3rd ODI at Hamilton abandoned without a ball bowled due to rain; India lead the series 2–0 with two matches left.
U19 Asia Cup: India U19 lose to Pakistan U19 by 3 wickets — Arjun Rajput's 107 helps India to 208, but Hamza Zahoor's unbeaten 100 wins it for Pakistan with 11 balls left.
AWCL: East Bengal lose 0–2 to April 25 SC in Kolkata but go through to the quarter-finals — the first Indian club to reach that stage.
2nd ODI, Wellington: India beat New Zealand by 4 runs (DLS) after rain ended play — NZ 134 in 41 overs, India 113/7 in 26. Gurnoor Brar is Player of the Match; India lead 2–0.
ISL: East Bengal lose 3–5 at Chennaiyin FC — Brison Fernandes scores twice in the first 18 minutes; Chennaiyin's first win of the season.
ISL: Inter Kashi lose 0–3 to SC Delhi in Pune — Fortes, Peña and Rodriguinho score.
